Appearance: Holy is a middle-aged woman of Western ancestry. In her first appearance, Holy wears a hoodie complete with a cape over undisclosed clothes, of which only the collar decorated with a capital "H" and the legs, covered in square metallic plates are revealed. She also has a white hat decorated with flowers and another "H". She was initially depicted as having sunglasses.

After her affliction worsens, part of Holy's body has turned into a massive chunk of stone that moves across her body. Holy has taken to writing on herself to keep important information within reach. Among other things, she has scribbled gradations on herself to measure the time she has left before the moving chunk of rock reaches her head, which makes her lose consciousness.
Color Schemes
Outfits
Personality: Holy suffers from an unknown type of mental disorder that makes her mistake people for objects, for instance, mistake a nurse for a pair of shoes. This is explained by the fact that parts of her brain are missing, although it is then revealed that she was the subject of inhuman trials conducted by the Locacaca Organization, who turned parts of her into rock. While under medical care, she can interact normally, capable of addressing Yasuho as another human being although she exhibits difficulties in reacting to what her interlocutor says. For instance, she ignores for a moment the fact that Yasuho came to inquire about her son.

Flashbacks at different periods show a gradual deterioration of her mental state. When she saved Josefumi Kujo, Holy acted normally. When Yasuho was 13, she displayed mild symptoms as she approached Yasuho out of the blue and offered insightful remarks, although it made little sense to Yasuho. At the time Josefumi and Kira were cultivating the Locacaca, she had trouble differentiating Josefumi from Kira but when reminded of it, she somewhat returned to her senses. Holy shows a certain fondness for reading. At one point in the past, Holy recommended the novel The Rose of Versailles to Josefumi, but by the beginning of the series she seems to have regressed to looking at racy magazines. Soon, her condition and mental state worsen to the point she tries to eat her own fingers off and can't seem to recognize people anymore.

In her rare moments of relative consciousness, Holy demonstrates that she's knowledgeable, wise, and insightful. After meeting with Yasuho, Holy does notice the girl's Stand and correctly guesses that she can be a valuable ally to her son and shows a belief in Fate. When she meets with Josuke, she is able to reveal practically everything she knows about the Locacaca Organization, has the presence of mind of bringing him to the Locacaca 6251's secret vault to administer it, and gives a crucial hint to Josuke in order to approach Satoru Akefu without pursuing him. In the past, she was shown to be a compassionate, dedicated doctor who was determined to save people, at one point doing everything in her power to save a dying Josefumi and imploring Kira to help save him. Even when she's mentally ill, Holy is quite amiable and likes to have conversations with everyone.
During her first appearance, Holy also exhibits a capacity to measure distances precisely with the naked eye, the same way Josuke measured lengths.
Holy holds her son Yoshikage in high regard, despite his disposition and attitude.
Abilities: Stand

Holy is implied to have a Stand or an ability of a similar nature as she was capable of seeing Paisley Park during Yasuho Hirose's TG University Hospital visit. She also seemingly recognized what it was and commented on how Yasuho was using it subconsciously.
Spiritual Connection
Josuke Higashikata and Holy share some sort of spiritual connection. She is able to sense Josuke's presence in the TG University Hospital.
Medical Background

As a former ophthalmologist at T.H. Medical University Hospital and an associate professor at Morioh's TG University, Holy is presumably a recognized expert in the medical field and a seasoned doctor of ocular treatment. In a flashback, she is portrayed as an emergency room practitioner who was capable of diagnosing Josefumi's condition and knew how to stabilize it through the use of her son's Stand ability. She is also noted to have had some background in the Locacaca fruit having created a laboratory solely for researching it.

personagens.resumo: Karera Sakunami (作並 カレラ, Sakunami Karera) is a tertiary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "Love Love Deluxe" story arc.

etymology.texto: 作 (Saku) = Work/production | 並 (Nami) = Something medium/average/common/ordinary

Appearance: Karera is a young woman of average height and a slim build. She has long curly dark hair, and her bangs are styled into several large curls. Above her curls, she wears a bandana with an angelfish printed on both sides and a clownfish printed on the top. Josefumi thinks she's cute.

She wears a cropped tube top with a zipper on the front and a pair of short shorts. On top of that, she has a long vest with each side on the front and back having a vertical pattern of oval-shaped holes in between two lines of smaller circular holes. Mesh-like suspenders attach her shirt to her shorts.
During her first appearance, she wears a pair of heeled gladiator sandals. After shopping, she wears striped thigh-high socks with a pair of ocean-themed heels decorated with stars and seashells.
Color Schemes
Personality: Karera is a temperamental, cunning, and crude woman who tends to pick fights with anyone in case she can benefit from them, irritating whoever she speaks to. She generally acts carefree and unpredictably. Although she is usually energetic and playful, she is prone to suddenly changing the subject and her mood. She is quite clingy and flirty with Josuke, whom she mistakes for being her crush, Josefumi. As soon as Josuke meets her, he can tell that she is the type of woman he would never love.

Karera has a surprisingly high number of bad habits. Firstly, Karera is a serial con artist, who exploits her Stand ability to commit several petty crimes and scams for her own benefit. She scams a yakitori vendor and later a taxi driver into giving her money by faking evidence that they provided her with bad customer service. She also manages to steal money from a credit card. She has experience with offering to grow hair for bald people in exchange for money, but as soon as her Stand goes out of range, the hair she grows for them just falls out. Karera starts most of her scamming cases by causing a big scene, aggressively yelling and swearing at her victims, and even assaulting them in the case of the yakitori vendor. Secondly, Karera is rather slovenly due to her current living style. For instance, she has no qualms about leaving a mess behind her after eating or cleaning the space between her toes in a restaurant by using water from a cup on the table. As she is homeless, she sleeps wherever she can such as a train station, and carries nothing with her except for a shopping bag. She begs Josuke for money as soon as she sees him just so she can spend it on pachinko, and after losing that money, she begs him for more. Karera is frequently seen snacking on various unhealthy foods. She nearly dumps an entire container of a cafe's cane sugar packets into her bag. She pours a lot of the sugar along with soy sauce onto tallow which she placed on top of bread, notably avoiding to eat the bread crusts. After buying a laptop, she charges it by using an outdoor outlet of a random stranger's house. She also has a characteristic staggering gait, always wobbling when she walks.

Karera hates to dwell on the past, going so far as to completely avoid associating herself with it, except for her unrequited love for Josefumi Kujo. She does not know or care about what her family is doing. For Karera, happiness depends on the treasured experiences she makes in the present. She claims that she dreams about becoming a fashion designer but has no talent for drawing, so she buys a laptop instead, planning to create her designs with CG software.

The subject of the Locacaca and the threat of the Rock Humans makes her nervous as she understands the stakes and danger they pose. Although she is a Stand user, Karera prefers to flee from her enemies, only coming to assist Josuke after leaving for long enough to be forgotten about so she can make a successful sneak attack. After she defeats the A. Phex Brothers, she states her resolve to not run anymore and declares that she wants the Locacaca for herself because it's worth a lot of money. She is also more knowledgeable than she acts, being aware of the equivalent exchange process and deciphering that Josefumi and Kira must have underwent equivalent exchange to become Josuke.
Abilities: Stand
Karera's Stand Love Love Deluxe gives her control over other people's hair, growing it on their heads and even on other things that they had touched, such as a tsukune or an ATM's LCD screen.

As noted by Yoshikage Kira, he has a very visible tan that causes him to stand out, which is much more visible in his later appearance. His most notable feature is his disfigured fingers, which Ojiro bit off down to the second joint due to the emotional distress caused by Kira's treatment of him.

When he meets Josuke, he is wearing a shirt with a bowtie, along with a jacket and gloves. All of his clothes have his Stand's "Q"-like symbol patterned across them. In his later appearances (both in flashbacks and after his reappearance in Chapter 87), he is bare-chested and wears a puffy jacket.

Later in JoJolion, he has his Stand's symbol tattooed onto his chest, prosthetic fingers to replace his missing ones, and cross-like markings in his hair. He also has belt and shoe buckles shaped like his Stand's symbol.
Color Schemes
Personality: Ojiro is a hateful man who lives a life of crime and hides his vileness beneath a friendly face.

Ojiro is a petty criminal whose crimes mostly revolve around taking advantage of women. He is shown for instance to forcefully take control of a woman with Fun Fun Fun and enjoy watching them stuck under the water. Even if he doesn't kill them, he believes that because of his Stand's power, he could theoretically get away with murder despite having never killed a person. He's also kidnapped a woman and forced her to stay locked up as part of a scheme to get at Yoshikage Kira. At some point, he takes photos of her in obscene poses and keeps them in a photo album to frame Kira. Ojiro also takes advantage of his oblivious girlfriend Maako, stealing her money behind her back. The full extent of Ojiro's vileness is shown when he seeks the Locacaca and tries to murder Jobin Higashikata and Tsurugi Higashikata in cold blood by forcing Jobin to slam shards of glass into their necks. He also does it without having any second thoughts or remorse. Finally, he's petty enough to steal money from a seemingly dead Jobin.

Ojiro desires to have revenge on Kira because his harassment broke him psychologically so much that he ate his own fingers. The one time they are shown together, it seems true that Kira intimidates and brutalizes Ojiro on a regular basis. However, he is said to still consider him a good friend. His "friendship" with Kira makes him feel entitled to take the Locacaca for his own personal gain, despite knowing that it was meant for Holy Joestar-Kira.

Aside from being sadistic and vengeful, Ojiro also demonstrates being a strategic and tactical person. In a desire to get his revenge on Kira, Ojiro set up multiple traps in Kira's apartment in hopes of using Fun Fun Fun on Kira. It's also revealed that Ojiro capturing the woman and leaving her completely naked in the apartment along with her bondage photos was to frame Kira of kidnapping and rape. He's also seemed to have memorized the location of the furniture in Kira's apartment as well, since from above he knew where the black sofa was in the below room. He performs another plan by sneakily controlling Tsurugi's hand to gather damning evidence and force Jobin's hand before killing him.

Ojiro likes to act friendly and always has a familiar tone with his interlocutor. For instance, his girlfriend Maako thinks the world of him and seems to sincerely love him. In reality, he is quite vulgar and unpleasant. At one point, he is shown antagonizing and aggravating a taxi driver because he's angered at the driver's suspiciousness and he's also shown being a slob, loitering around and not cleaning up after eating. Ojiro seems to be lazy, since his main activity is being a surfer and how Maako's daughter calls him out on sleeping in.

Ojiro has a somewhat optimistic and affable outlook on life. Even when he's on a mission, Ojiro likes to enjoy the little things (for instance the Higashikata Fruit Parlor's delicious ice cream). Ojiro is proud of being a surfer and defines himself by this activity even though it is not a real job.
Abilities: Stand
Ojiro's Stand is Fun Fun Fun, with the ability to control the body of a person underneath him.
Personal Skills

Trap Expertise: During his fight with Josuke in Kira's apartment, Ojiro is shown to be skilled in making sharp traps out of mundane objects, tricking the target into touching them before exploiting their injuries sustained from the traps by using his Stand's ability to manipulate their limbs.

personagens.resumo: Tamaki Damo (田最 環, Damo Tamaki) is a primary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, and introduced in the "Hato Brought Her Boyfriend Home" story arc.

namesake.texto: Can (German rock band) | Damo Suzuki (Former Can vocalist)

etymology.texto: 田 (Da) = Rice field/Rice paddy | 最 (Mo) = Most/-est | 環 (Tamaki) = Ring

cod.texto: Head obliterated by Josuke Higashikata

Appearance: Tamaki Damo claims he is 23, though he appears much older, seeing as his hair is styled into a comb-over to hide his bald spot. His facial hair is styled into a goatee and horseshoe mustache. He is introduced wearing aviator sunglasses and a dark-colored tracksuit with spiked sleeves and an image of a saxophone on the left breast. He is much shorter than Hato and is considerably overweight.
Color Schemes
Personality: Damo is introduced as an awkward but polite individual when he meets the Higashikata family, notably mumbling while speaking to Norisuke IV and Joshu, insisting on sitting on the guest's seat even if he breaks it, and somehow ignoring when his combover is messed up with. This is later revealed to be a facade hiding a much colder and calculated personality, which he unveils while interrogating Norisuke.

Not much is seen of Damo's everyday activities, but he takes running the Locacaca trade seriously, meticulously ensuring that it goes unnoticed and taking swift and ruthless action when it is threatened in any way. His interest in the profit a Locacaca hybrid will bring him even on the verge of death indicates that he does it out of greed.

His power having limited range, Damo's modus operandi is to infiltrate a place where his targets will be trapped in, then plant Vitamin C's handprints all over the place so that everyone will be melting and powerless. Damo enjoys lording over his victims, ordering them around in his position of power but goes rather straight to his point, being focused on his objectives. He also sadistically tortures and humiliates his victims, inserting various common-place objects into them and once videotaping it for his own enjoyment. In contrast, Damo has a tendency to "spare" one of his victims for various reasons, such as self-punishment for being careless or excessive cruelty. Damo has also a penchant for cutting off limbs with a 1,000 yen bill if they do not comply.

Tamaki Damo has a short temper, regularly letting out short bursts of anger accompanied by a similarly violent action and insults. Being underestimated, even remotely, such as thinking that keeping information is being hidden or seemingly playing dumb, enrages him. However, he can acknowledge one's merits rather easily, praising Yoshikage Kira and Josefumi Kujo for managing to steal a Locacaca branch.

Damo is manipulative, seducing Hato with the specific purpose of approaching and interrogating her family, and had no qualms with torturing and killing them all, including Hato herself. He has a habit of exploiting possible pressure points such as Josefumi's fundamental lack of interests in helping Yoshikage Kira, Norisuke's love for his family, and Hato's affection for her father to gain leverage or an advantage in a fight. When he has no further use for a pawn like Hato, he's ready to dispose of them and get them out of his way. He is also shown to be cowardly when his life is truly threatened, begging Hato to spare him and trying to convince Josuke Higashikata they should team up.
Abilities: Stand

Damo's Stand Vitamin C enables him to "soften" human bodies to turn them into something as malleable as putty or as viscous as liquid. He then takes advantage of his victim's softened state to torture them for information or kill them outright. He typically cuts them with 1,000 yen bills or other thin objects.
On one occasion, Damo even inserts a living fish inside his victim's body and watches it swim.

personagens.resumo: Yotsuyu Yagiyama (八木山 夜露, Yagiyama Yotsuyu) is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. He is shown at the end of the Paper Moon Deception story arc and fully introduced in the "Norisuke Higashikata, Tsurugi Higashikata, and Yotsuyu Yagiyama" story arc.

notableworks.texto: Higashikata Residence | Higashikata Fruit Parlor | Morioh Stadium

etymology.texto: 八 (Ya) = Eight | 木 (Gi) = Tree | 山 (Yama) = Mountain | 夜露 (Yotsuyu) = Night dew

cod.texto: Suffocated from lack of skin respiration

mangadebut.texto: JJL Chapter 25 (Eyes only) | JJL Chapter 26 (1st full debut)

Appearance: Yagiyama is a Rock Human of slim build and average to above-average height. He claims to be 28 years old. He has shoulder-length, straight black hair with short bangs. His eyes are black with small triangular highlights.

He wears a headpiece of leaves and a collar with a pin bearing the letter H. His arms, stomach, and legs are clad in a dark, leathery material studded with small metallic spikes. Over this, he wears a crop top and a pair of floral-printed bloomers. Attached to his belt is a small pouch.
Color Schemes
Personality: Yotsuyu Yagiyama is an ambitious and ruthless Rock Human.
Yotsuyu states that above all he desires social status and at one point even declares his intention to steal Norisuke Higashikata IV's fortune.

He is quite aggressive and calculating, as he repeatedly takes underhanded measures to fulfill his goals. As Josuke states, Yotsuyu is the type of person who will attack innocent people in order to show he is serious about his threats. For instance, during his first appearance, Yotsuyu waterboards Yasuho Hirose to force her to bring out her Stand, later taking her hostage to use her as bait and draw Josuke out into the open. He also demonstrates manipulative prowess when exploiting Tsurugi's fear of his family's disease in order to coerce him into assisting in trapping Josuke. As a member of the Locacaca Organization, Yotsuyu shows a vested interest in the Locacaca and notably sought to kill Josuke Higashikata, the amnesiac being a loose end who knows the fruit's secret.

Yotsuyu also demonstrates a tendency for tactical thinking and analyzing a fight. He frequently uses chess metaphors and openly analyzes the situation to assert who has the advantage in combat. However, when Josuke outsmarts him and forces him to either drown or reveal information about the Locacaca Organization, Yotsuyu prefers to perform a last-ditch attack and sacrifice his life.

Despite his ruthlessness and the natural sociopathy of Rock Humans, Yotsuyu seemed to have a genuine friendship with Aisho, and Aisho recalls the architect in a positive and helpful light. Yagiyama woke up Aisho to save him from being killed when his house was demolished, and was sympathetic and supportive of the more naive Aisho after he found out his girlfriend had betrayed him.
Yotsuyu has a particular opinion about Stands that are controlled unconsciously, finding them to be the "cutest, nicest kind."
Abilities: Stand

When Yotsuyu touches someone, the victim begins to naturally attract specific objects toward them. Additionally, Yotsuyu is able to attract rocks to himself to cause damage to people or objects close to him.
Rock Physiology

While similar to a human's, Yotsuyu's body can change into a rock-like form. Because of this, he does not need to sleep or rest. He can mimic rocks to the point that he becomes indistinguishable from them. Norisuke theorizes that Yotsuyu's physiology requires him to have at least a small amount of skin respiration; in the absence of such, his body structure will begin to break down as a result of being less structurally stable than an ordinary human's.
Eye Fluid Membrane

Yotsuyu is able to produce a transparent and flexible membrane from his eyes, which he uses to waterboard Yasuho. It is unclear whether this is a trait that all Rock Humans possess, or whether I Am a Rock enables this ability.

personagens.resumo: Aisho Dainenjiyama (大年寺山 愛唱, Dainenjiyama Aishō) is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, most notably in the "Doobie Wah" story arc.

occupation.texto: Security Guard at Morioh Stadium | Locacaca Seller

etymology.texto: 大 (Dai) = Big/Large | 年 (Nen) = Year | 寺 (Ji) = Temple | 山 (Yama) = Mountain | 愛唱 (Aisho) = Loving to sing

family.texto: Unnamed Ex-Girlfriend

cod.texto: Fatally shattered to pieces via bus collision

Appearance: Aisho is a slender man of average to below average height. His outfit is composed of a skin-tight black bodysuit with a hole in the chest, a khaki shorts with a belt, and a two-toned layered arm sleeves. He dons what appears to be a knitted wrap scarf with sleeves tied around his neck. He also wears a pair of sleeves around his head, similar to the pattern on his neck wrap scarf, with some of his hair poking out through the holes.

In a flashback with his former girlfriend, he wears an open-front hooded jacket that has decorative pompoms from the top of the hood until the shoulder, bearing resemblance to the spikes of a Locacaca fruit, along with plain shirt and pants. Underneath the hood, he also wears a knit cap.
Color Schemes
Personality: Despite his initial stoic facade, Aisho is a paranoid man who easily gets nervous most of the time. He tends to overreact and notice small things, such as when a group of birds in the park all stared at his direction. He can be frightened and intimidated by unseen enemies. However, this paranoia served useful to him, especially when he deduced that there were two people tailing him, Yasuho Hirose and Tsurugi Higashikata, and that they were also Stand users. He would also briefly experience sudden flashbacks to previous traumatic experiences. Aisho's nervousness may be attributed to some form of heart condition, as evident with him taking pills for his heart, since he is commonly shown with his heart rapidly beating during strenuous situations.

Although Aisho seems to have had a genuine love for his former girlfriend, he is somewhat gullible and can be quickly swayed. His misplaced trust culminated in her cheating on him and selling his house while he slept in his rock form. Later, Josefumi Kujo and Yoshikage Kira influenced him into buying a specific medicine by making him believe it was highly sought after, even if he didn't seem to need the medicine, in order to secretly steal the Locacaca fruit that he had been possessing.

As a member of the Locacaca Organization, Aisho is ready to kill anyone who might learn the secret of the Locacaca, and was ready to kill Tsurugi, a little boy and the son of his associate Jobin Higashikata, in cold blood.

Due to Aisho's rock physiology, he is unable to wake up for at least a month every time he falls asleep. This, along with his naivete, resulted in his former girlfriend selling his house during his dormancy.
Abilities: Stand

Aisho's Stand Doobie Wah! is able to create miniature tornadoes that automatically pursue its targets. It is capable of cutting flesh using the tornadoes' bases. This Stand is incredibly powerful, almost impossible to avoid or negate without ceasing to breathe entirely.

personagens.resumo: The A. Phex Brothers (エイ・フェックス兄弟, Ei Fekkusu Kyōdai) are secondary antagonists featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "Love Love Deluxe" story arc.

ja_kanji.texto: エイ・フェックス兄弟

stand.texto: Schott Key No.1 (Elder brother) | Schott Key No.2 (Younger brother)

family.texto: Themselves (twins)

cod.texto: Incinerated by Karera Sakunami (Elder brother) | Poisoned by his own Schott Key No.2's gas (Younger brother)

Appearance: Although both brothers are identical in appearance and attire, they have small differences to distinguish one another. Besides the elder brother's damaged right arm that has Schott Key No.1, the elder brother has his ear piercing on his left ear whereas the younger brother has his on his right ear. Sporting nearly shaven heads with intricate sideburn designs and neck-length ponytails, they wear long-sleeved decorated shirts and shorts which are reminiscent of typical footballer clothing, the latter of which were first shown to have a serrated bottom. Their eyes are squinted to the point of appearing shut a majority of the time.
Color Schemes
Personality: The pair share a duality described as harmonious with one another, being based on the Japanese concept of 'A-un', which explains the connected nature of opposites and their seemingly contradictory similarities.

Aside from that, the elder of the two brothers seems to be the one in charge, and was the only one to speak at first, but the younger brother speaks as well later on. The elder brother is the one who communicates with the policemen in place of his brother and the one who displays a Stand power; his brother however would later reveal he also possessed a Stand - hidden in his soccer ball bag. The younger brother is more reserved, preferring to let his older brother do most of the talking. The younger brother also has a habit of kicking around his Stand's container and performing tricks with it, not unlike, and in the guise of, a soccer player. In fact, he is said to have kept a ball with him at all times ever since he was a kid.

As twins, the A. Phex Brothers get along well and the older brother even protects and supports his brother, saying that it is not his fault that he attracted attention by playing with the ball. The two have also developed good teamwork in combat, using their abilities in unison to take their enemies by surprise.

As members of the Locacaca Organization, the A. Phex Brothers are quite accustomed to violent actions towards those in their way. They brutalize a couple of policemen who wanted to arrest them, set Karera Sakunami on fire to dispose of her and when Josuke interposes himself, they quickly decide to kill him as well. They do show some restraint and are able to calmly ask random citizens about the whereabouts of their target.
Abilities: Stands
Schott Key No.1

The Stand of the elder brother, Schott Key No. 1, can shift objects touched with his left hand to the stub on his right. He can manipulate the way it materializes for a variety of strategic advantages. The first example of this is shown during the confrontation between the brothers and a pair of police officers who attempt to ascertain the identity of the brothers. Objects transported in this fashion will seem to break down and crumble while the material reassembles on the other end.
Schott Key No.2

The younger brother's Stand, Schott Key No. 2, possesses the ability to release potentially fatal toxic gas whenever the Stand's container is opened. Its effect induces a bloody cough when inhaled, and quickly corrodes skin that comes in contact with it. The gas can be transported by Schott Key No. 1 to give the elder brother a deadly technique in combat.
Rock Physiology

While similar to a human's, their bodies can presumably change into rock. Because of this, they do not need to sleep or rest. They can mimic rocks to the point that it makes them indistinguishable from them.

Norisuke theorizes that Yotsuyu's physiology requires him to have at least a small amount of skin respiration and in the absence of such his body structure will begin to break down due to it becoming less structurally stable than an ordinary human's. This could be a trait shared by other Rock humans, including the A. Phex Brothers.
Miscellaneous

The younger brother demonstrates versatile and dynamic control of his soccer ball common of experts, capable of moving it between his legs and head effortlessly and kicking it with enough force and power that it could be considered an attack of its own.

personagens.resumo: Dolomite (ドロミテ, Doromite), formerly known as Masaji Dorokoma (泥駒 政次, Dorokoma Masaji), is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "Dolomite's Blue Lagoon" story arc.

alias.texto: Masaji Dorokoma (泥駒 政次Dorokoma MasajiDorokoma Masaji)

etymology.texto: 泥 (Doro) = Mud | 駒 (Koma) = Someone controlled by another | 政 (Masa) = Government/politics/rule | 次 (Ji) = Next, secondary

Appearance: Dolomite was originally a normal looking man. Wearing an undercut, the hair on his sides was shaved down whilst the hair on his crown was pulled to the right of his forehead. He wore an exotic striped jacket over a dark, long-sleeved shirt.

After his body was destroyed, Dolomite's appearance drastically changed. His entire body and skin took on a more rock-like appearance, with a rougher complexion and cracks in his skin. Dolomite's arms and legs are reduced to stumps, on which he wears small round piercings, while his teeth are broken and cracked. His eyes are duller and a strange marking exists above his nose, in the form of a triangle with a small circle above it. His hair has grown out much longer and is unkempt, hanging over his shoulders. As for clothing, he still retains his exotic jacket but nothing else.
Color Schemes
Personality: Little is known of Dolomite's past personality. In the past, Dolomite was an easy-going man. His idea of paradise was inspired by the novel The Blue Lagoon, referring to a tropical paradise isolated from the rest of the world. At that time, he also cared for another woman. In fact, he saved her from electrocution at the cost of his own body. Dolomite still harbors some feelings for her and expressed a desire to seek her out and invite her to the "Blue Lagoon".

Despite the destruction of his body, his mind is relatively sane, although he does display animalistic behavior at times. He is also extremely nihilistic, likely due to the fact he cannot participate in society any more. He is not interested in the Locacaca operation, and whilst commenting that it will be "lonely", he does not show any grief to his fellow Rock Humans. The reason given as he has nobody left, he can not participate in an equivalent exchange process. While Dolomite states he is actually content with living near the Mutsu-kabe Shrine pond, he becomes interested in the new Locacaca's healing properties when Jobin explains Josuke Higashikata's history and cooperates with Jobin. Despite his independence, he is aware of the existence of the Locacaca Organization's upper echelons and is frightened by them, to the point he warns Josuke and Yasuho to not seek the Locacaca further.

As a Rock Human, Dolomite has little concern about harming humans. His crude control over people means that they will probably harm themselves as they try to grab a target, and Dolomite was ready to drown Josuke when he was done with him. However, he shows a measure of restraint when he asks Jobin first if the latter is alright with collateral damage.

Dolomite mostly eats frogs by turning into rock and luring them near him, but seems to be fond of fried chicken, as it is the food Jobin used to lure him out. It is known that he also attacked pet pens or farms in order to eat rabbits and chickens.
Abilities: Stand
Dolomite's Stand has the power to control humans from afar to attack a particular target so long as that person has touched something belonging to the user, or the blood of one of the victims.

personagens.resumo: Urban Guerrilla (アーバン・ゲリラ, Āban Gerira), otherwise known as Ryo Shimosato (下里 良, Shimosato Ryō), is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "Urban Guerrilla and Doremifasolati Do" story arc.

alias.texto: Ryo Shimosato (下里 良Shimosato RyōShimosato Ryō)

etymology.texto: 下 (Shimo) = The lower portion/end | 里 (Sato) = Village | 良 (Ryo) = Good

family.texto: Doremifasolati Do (pet)

cod.texto: Blown to pieces by Josuke Higashikata

mangadebut.texto: JJL Chapter 65 (Mentioned)Mentioned only | JJL Chapter 67 (1st full debut)

Appearance: Urban Guerrilla is a well-built Rock Human, dressed in minimal clothing. He wears a set of bracers on his forearms and a pair of pants with three vents on the thighs and metal knee guards. Over Urban Guerrilla's head is a complex hood that features a breathing apparatus hooked into his mouth, along with goggles stylized with six-pronged eyelashes and a lens wiper on the left side.
However, when in public Urban Guerrilla assumes the appearance of a normal doctor in uniform, complete with glasses. He's also revealed to have short hair.
Urban Guerrilla seems to constantly bare his teeth.
Color Schemes
Personality: Urban Guerrilla is an animalistic Rock Human, grunting and growling while speaking. When stalking his targets, he devises a "killing order" to select who he'll assassinate first based on their threat level. Urban Guerrilla also displays an intense and disturbing side when frustrated, stating to Rai Mamezuku that he'd take his time dismembering and mutilating Mamezuku's body. Despite his brutality, Urban Guerrilla is efficient in his work and intelligent; observing his enemies before attacking and making sure to take needed precautions.

Urban Guerrilla is disdainful of humans and dreams that one day the Rock Humans will stand above humanity, planning to use the new variety of the Locacaca to do so. Despite his specieist views towards human beings, he still praises Josuke as a "marvel of biology" due to Josuke's nature as a fusion between Josefumi Kujo and Yoshikage Kira.

As a doctor at TG University Hospital (specialist in gastrointestinal diseases), it can be inferred that Urban Guerrilla was bright enough to exercise his job or obtain his medical license by himself.
Abilities: Stand

Urban Guerrilla's Stand Brain Storm is a multi-unit in the form of burr puzzles sent out from his hands. It mimics the effects of certain bacteria by melting the flesh of anyone touching it and creating holes in its victim's body.

personagens.resumo: Doremifasolati Do (ドレミファソラティ・ド, Doremifasorati Do) is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in the "Urban Guerrilla and Doremifasolati Do" story arc.

ja_kanji.texto: ドレミファソラティ・ド

alias.texto: Solati Do (ソラティ・ドSorati DoSorati Do) (by Urban Guerrilla & Poor Tom)

family.texto: Urban Guerrilla (Master)

cod.texto: Blown to pieces via Josuke Higashikata

Appearance: Doremifasolati Do is described as a Rock Animal with a caterpillar-like body. Its face vaguely resembles that of a dog or bear with the tongue constantly sticking out. Its head sports several grooves, having deeper grooves extending from its eye-sockets. The rest of its torso is made up of several flat rectangular stones, adorned with designs resembling human arms. These flat stones provide excellent defense from attacks and can be shifted rapidly like tank treads to mobilize underground.
There are thin appendages covering each side of Doremifasolati Do's face, resembling horse blinders. Beside them, it has spiked circular stones which function as wheels.

On each side of Doremifasolati Do's torso are two stones that are topped with spinning rock-like human hands. Doremifasolati Do has a caterpillar-shaped tail that is made up of stones and can also become humanoid legs, allowing it to stand when above ground. Its torso lacks any internal organs, instead being a hollow pouch. This functions as a makeshift cockpit, allowing a person to hide within its body like a shell.
Color Schemes
Personality: Doremifasolati Do displays a very low level of intelligence and doesn't exhibit any notable personality traits. It follows Urban Guerrilla and protects him from harm, implying a sense of loyalty and basic intelligence.
It's mentioned that its diet may consist of insects or roots inside the ground, or possibly the dirt itself. It uses its nose to sniff around and tongue to lick objects.
Abilities: Subterranean Travel

Doremifasolati Do can be ridden like a tank and is capable of traveling underground, controlling and shifting any trees in its path. Its primary weakness is water as well as urban or industrialized locations where it is heavily impeded by concrete covering the soil. Its wheels on the side of its face can't break through bedrock, but can finely break soil.
Caterpillar Propulsion

As it breaks up the ground and pushes its way through the soil, the earth and sand fuse with its body and are sent back out behind it. It moves by making the soil itself into a caterpillar track so there are barely any surface-level vibrations and no visible remnants of where it's dug, while also protecting its rider. Its propulsion is fast enough to pass Soft & Wet's bubbles through itself before Josuke can use them.

personagens.resumo: Poor Tom (プアー・トム, Puā Tomu) is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in the "Ozon Baby's Pressure" story arc.

family.texto: Unnamed girlfriend

cod.texto: Fatally shot through the head as a result of pursuing Toru

Appearance: Poor Tom is a short, overweight man, who can easily be mistaken for a child due to his height and youthful face. Despite his child-like appearance, Tom is covered in wrinkles and is seen smoking cigarettes. His hair is flat with a small bang over his forehead. Most of his hair is notably shaved in a curved shape with short spikes of hair protruding from it, leaving only a small circular patch of hair on the center.

Aside from his shorts and sandals, a majority of Tom's attire appears to be drawn onto his body with certain parts shaded in. Other drawn-on accessories include a tie with his name on it, a "Coda" pin, referencing the Led Zeppelin album, and a pocket watch.
He also possesses a doctor's uniform tailored to him, which he wears when working at the TG University Hospital.
Color Schemes
Personality: Poor Tom is a vulgar and devious Rock Human.

Belying his appearance, Tom has a rather vulgar personality. He claims to have a girlfriend and still eyes other women, using his size to look under their skirts. He also speaks in a familiar tone. Poor Tom smokes as well.

Poor Tom is also quite devious and has some tactical acumen. He accurately analyzes the situation after Urban Guerrilla doesn't report to him and quickly goes to Jobin to enlist him. In a bold move, he reveals a part of his Stand's secret to Jobin and decides to completely close off the entirety of the Higashikata's orchard to simply make Josuke unable to approach the Locacaca. Poor Tom is additionally malicious in his intent, withholding information from Jobin that his Stand would not only target Josuke and Rai Mamezuku but the entire Higashikata family too. Planning to take his time once Jobin and everyone in his way is dead, Tom would search for the Locacaca at his leisure.

As a Rock Human and member of the Locacaca Organization, Poor Tom is callous about human lives and is ready to kill anyone in his way. For instance, he trapped the entire Higashikata Family and planned on killing them and brutally attacked Rai Mamezuku with his ability.

However, Poor Tom displays a cowardly and desperate side to his personality when his life is truly threatened. After being cornered by Josuke, Poor Tom resorts to begging and pleading for his life; offering Josuke large amounts of money to spare him.
As a doctor specialized in obstetrics, it can be inferred that Poor Tom was bright enough to obtain his medical license by himself or at least perform his job well enough without raising suspicion.
Abilities: Stand

Poor Tom's Stand Ozon Baby has the power to seal off an entire area once its physical representation, a LEGO White House replica, is buried underground. Once buried, the area will be affected by an intense depressurization that attacks indiscriminately.

personagens.resumo: Wu Tomoki (羽 伴毅, Ū Tomoki),[b] also known as Doctor Wu (ドクターウー, Dokutā Ū), is a secondary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in the "Doctor Wu and Awaking 3 Leaves" story arc.

alias.texto: Doctor Wu (ドクターウーDokutā ŪDokutā Ū)

etymology.texto: 羽 (Wu) = Feather/plumage/wing | 伴 (Tomo) = Consort | 毅 (Ki) = Strong

cod.texto: Suffocated by medicinal cement

mangadebut.texto: JJL Chapter 76 (Silhouette) | JJL Chapter 77 (1st full debut)

Appearance: Despite having a punch perm, Wu Tomoki's hair is straight and primarily consists of small light-colored spheres. He has dark spiked bangs covering the front, with similar tufts of hair outlining the top of his head. His uniform features a long closed jacket with three "DoCToR" name tags on it: two on the front and one on his shoulder.
Color Schemes
Personality: At first glance, Wu appears to be polite and calm while working with patients. He is shown to temporarily derail conversations in order to indulge in an eccentric eating habit, which includes consuming excessive amounts of nori and silicon-infused water in short bursts. That being said, he seems to typically ask for permission from his patient before snacking.

Wu's real demeanor is shown to be a perfectionist, claiming that he has never experienced failure once in his entire life; citing very important events such as exams as proof of his self-proclaimed infallibility. He even goes so far as to say that he's never failed at love, never approaching women if he senses that there might be anything wrong with them.

Wu considers himself to be a righteous doctor who will heal anyone that comes to him, without fail. He treats the Locacaca as a "public good" used to heal others, in contrast to those with more personal intentions like Josuke. As a consequence, he also considers that anything he does to heal his patients, however evil or vulgar it may be, will be forgiven as long as the treatment is a success. He is emotionless and android-like, with no moral or ethical standards.

Wu is also very secretive about his involvement with the Locacaca Organization. He goes to very extreme lengths to keep information from those who could potentially be a threat, disassembling and hiding an entire wheelchair and seemingly vanishing moments after treating a patient to avoid confrontation with Yasuho when she becomes suspicious of Mitsuba's presence at the hospital.
He naturally causes sexual harassment due to his ability, but it is unintentional. Wu also enjoys riding in ambulances, and gets excited by storms and calamities.[a]
Abilities: Stand

Wu Tomoki's Stand Doctor Wu has the power to let him break his body up into its stony fragments at will and then use these fragments to enter people's bodies. Not only does his Rock Human physiology cause allergic reactions in his victims, but if his body fragments fuse with the victim's skeleton, he can gain partial control over their bodies.

personagens.resumo: Suzuyo Hirose (広瀬 鈴世, Hirose Suzuyo) is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.

etymology.texto: 広 (Hiro) = Vast | 瀬 (Se) = Current/rapids | 鈴 (Suzu) = Bell/Chime | 世 (Yo) = World/Society

family.texto: Unnamed Ex-husband | Yasuho Hirose (Daughter)

Appearance: Suzuyo initially has long dark hair tied into several pigtails with spherical hair clips, just like her daughter. She wears a plain sleeveless U-neck dress, a belt with two roses attached to it, and high heels.
Later, she is seen with a braided ponytail and a dress embroidered with multiple circular patterns.
Color Schemes
Personality: Suzuyo is an irresponsible and carefree woman. Though she wishes to mend things with Yasuho, their relationship is often strained because of her. She enjoys a profligate lifestyle doing things such as playing video games and drinking alcohol often. On one occasion, Yasuho discovers Suzuyo drunk and asleep on the floor of her house with a hickey on her chest. Moreover, it is shown that she once left Yasuho at a summer camp in order to have a vacation in Okinawa.

Suzuyo is quite immature for her age, and this attitude strains her relationship with her daughter. Though they both seek to mend things, Suzuyo's personality and Yasuho's growing apathy towards her mother repeatedly tarnish things. Yasuho is often disappointed by her mother, and Suzuyo herself is cruel at times. She teases Yasuho about whether she has a boyfriend, warning her not to get taken in by the "crazy naked guy" she found crawling near the Wall Eyes, and then condescendingly laughing.

Despite her challenged relationship with her daughter, Suzuyo still cares for Yasuho by offering to cook and often wonders where she goes when she leaves the house. Even when Yasuho was a young girl did Suzuyo never mean to hurt her, but her often cold, apathetic attitude towards Yasuho crippled her trust.
Yasuho predicts that she and her father shared a loving bond at some point. However, Suzuyo never spoke about him after their divorce.

personagens.resumo: Palawanicus No.36 (パラワンオオヒラタ-36, Parawan'ōhirata-36), also known as just P-36 (P-36号, P-36-gō), is a tertiary ally featured in the eight part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically the "It's a Summer Vacation Everyday" story arc.

family.texto: Josuke Higashikata (Owner) | Jobin Higashikata (Former Owner)

Appearance: Palawanicus No.36 appears as a Dorcus titanus, with a segmented body, six legs and a set of mandibles which Josuke observes to be bigger than that of Palawanicus No.28. It is 112 mm (4.4 in) long, with Norisuke Higashikata IV noting it to almost be a world record.

A star-shaped sticker is applied to the beetle's shell prior to the start of the first match in order to differentiate it from its opponent. During its battle with the Jobin's Rosenbergi, its right mandible, wing as well as its middle and front left legs are all broken off.
Color Schemes
Personality: Like the rest of Jobin Higashikata's collection, P-36 is an elite athlete, intelligent, aggressive and assertive in mating. Its intelligence spans it a 45-second attention span before it forgets. To draw out its complete potential in its fight with Palawanicus No.28, Josuke uses female pheromones to stimulate it. Palawanicus No.36 also has a great deal of endurance, able to repeatedly lose limbs and keep fighting.

Joshu Higashikata notes No.36 has a strong fighting spirit, still fighting even when on the edge of the ring. Because of its fighting spirit, it has a feel for winning, which gives it motivation to get stronger and become a better warrior.
Abilities: Strength

Palawanicus No.36, like the rest of Jobin's collection, is an athlete specially trained to be an elite. To keep up with this training and survive Winter, it can only eat protein. As a result, it can live up to five years, far beyond beetles living in nature. As such, the Palawanicus has far greater physical capabilities relative to its size, able to lift one of its own species of equal size using only one mandible. Its endurance also allows it to lose limbs in battles which can be glued back later.
Intelligence

Although smarter than many species, the Palawanicus is limited by its intelligence, as it only has a short, 45-second attention span before forgetting. As such, it ceases to fight after enough time is spent.

personagens.resumo: Kiyomi Kujo (空条 聖美, Kūjō Kiyomi) is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.

namesake.texto: Seiko Kujo[a] | Hōjō clan (Samurai family of the Kamakura shogunate)

etymology.texto: 空 (Ku) = Empty air | 条 (Jo) = Article in a document | 聖 (Kiyo) = Holy | 美 (Mi) = Beauty/beautiful

family.texto: Unnamed Father | Sadafumi Kujo (Ex-Husband) | Josefumi Kujo (Son) | Josuke Higashikata (son from Josefumi's part) | Unnamed child

Appearance: Kiyomi is a beautiful young woman. She has long light hair with bangs tapered to the sides. The top of her hair seems to be braided on the sides and back of her head. She is only shown wearing a swimsuit while on the beach.
Color Schemes
Personality: Kiyomi is irresponsible and neglectful toward her son. Instead of going to work, she would take several days off and relax on the beach. She goes as far as taking Unisom sleeping pills before calling her workplace to feign sleepiness.

She also doesn't bother saving her own son and watches him drown. Although she appears worried initially, Kiyomi thinks it may be better to let Josefumi die so she could be free, as two men previously stopped flirting with her after seeing she has a kid. After Yoshikage Kira saves Josefumi from dying, Kira points out that Kiyomi looked like she was feeling something else rather than relief. Despite her negligence, and after seemingly abandoning him, Kiyomi kept photos of Josefumi on her phone, still looking for her son.

personagens.resumo: Maako Kitani (喜谷 真亜子, Kitani Maako), also known as Makorin (マコリン), is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. She has one daughter and is the girlfriend of Ojiro Sasame.

occupation.texto: Seiten Birdies Owner | Seiten Holdings CEO

etymology.texto: 喜 (Ki) = Joy/delight/pleasure | 谷 (Tani) = Valley | 真 (Ma) = Truth/reality/genuineness | 亜 (A) = Ranking next/coming after/sub- | 子 (Ko) = A common suffix used in Female name endings, meaning Child or A dear or desired girl

cod.texto: Cerebral infarction caused by Speed King

mangafinal.texto: JJL Chapter 91 (Photo)Only appears in a photo

Appearance: Maako is a short, overweight woman with long wavy dark hair. She wears a necklace with a locket shaped like an "M" and a sleeveless dress.
Color Schemes
Personality: Maako is greedy and selfish, acting sociable and friendly with others to get what she wants. However, she is willing to lavishly spend her money on her boyfriend, oblivious that Ojiro is stealing extra money and taking advantage of her. She is not afraid to bend the law to further her goals. Her condo and stadium were built on top of a weak foundation and she had to bend the law to get a building permit. She is also narcissistic, calling her own hand cute and complaining that Mitsuba insulted her despite Mitsuba only being a housewife.

personagens.resumo: The unnamed Kidnapped Girl (裸の女性, Hadaka no Josei) is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in the "Soft & Wet" story arc.

family.texto: Unnamed Parents

Appearance: She is a young woman of average build and height. She has dark eyes and dark shoulder-length hair that, once out the bath, is loosely parted to the right and tucked behind her ears. She appears completely nude in almost every scene. While under the control of Ojiro's Stand, Fun Fun Fun, she also has four red "Q"-shaped brands on her hands and feet.
Color Schemes
Personality: When Josuke discovers the woman kidnapped by Ojiro in the bathroom, she initially appears unconcerned about her situation, likely mistaking him for her abductee. However, her demeanor drastically changes once she spots Yasuho, desperately begging for them to help her escape. Although not a Stand user herself, she's keenly aware of Ojiro's Stand ability, and thus remains mostly silent to avoid attracting her kidnapper's attention. Despite offering Josuke helpful advice and warning him about Ojiro's attacks, she mostly cowers in the corner and tries to avoid getting herself involved.

Having been exploited by others her entire life, the woman has come to view herself as nothing more than an object to be used and discarded. As a result of her past experiences, she has become distrustful of others and puts her own well-being above all else. When Ojiro calls her from inside the apartment, she reluctantly picks up the phone and chooses to betray Josuke in order to save herself, blaming him for getting her involved in the first place. However, after Ojiro's defeat, she ultimately sides with him again and assists him in identifying her abductor.

personagens.resumo: Iwasuke (岩助, Iwasuke) is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.

etymology.texto: 岩 (Iwa) = Rock | 助 (Suke) = Help, assistance (From Josuke)

family.texto: Tsurugi Higashikata (Caretaker)See: Higashikata Family

Appearance: Iwasuke is a medium-sized dog resembling a striped hyena or aardwolf, though without the stripes of those species. Although he primarily has light-colored fur, he notably has a dark mane like a mohawk running from the top of his head to his back. His ears are either pointed or floppy when he is comfortable and he has a thin tail with a thick clump of fur at the end.

His muzzle resembles that of a Pomeranian or Spitz. JOJO magazine 2025 SUMMER suggests that if he's a Pomeranian, then his fur might have been trimmed or he has a condition that caused fur loss aside from on his back.
Color Schemes
Personality: Iwasuke is an obedient pet and easily forms an attachment to his owner, Tsurugi Higashikata. True to his curious tendencies as a stray animal, he primarily roamed around the springs at the area of the Morioh Wall Eyes and the Higashikata estate, which ultimately led him to eat a Locacaca fruit at some point during the Morioh earthquake. In spite of this, he easily became loyal to Tsurugi after he was taken in to live with the Higashikata Family in their home.

In the Higashikata estate, Iwasuke often strolls around when he is not around Tsurugi. He can be a perky house pet, as seen when he playfully pretended to bite Tsurugi's finger when the latter covered his nostrils for fun.
Abilities: Rock Skin
As a Rock Animal, Iwasuke can shift his outer appearance from a normal dog into a rock-like state and vice versa at will. His hardened skin is durable enough to withstand Ozon Baby's pressure.
Intangibility
Iwasuke is capable of phasing through walls.

personagens.resumo: Zaihei Nigatake (苦竹 財平, Nigatake Zaihei) is a tertiary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.

etymology.texto: 苦 (Niga) = Bitter | 竹 (Take) = Bamboo | 財 (Zai) = Money/wealth/riches | 平 (Hei) = Something neither high nor low/something calm

Appearance: Zaihei is a man of average height and build, and has short dark hair. He wears a tunic that ends up in flaps on the bottom, and dark-colored pants with some stripes.
Color Schemes
Personality: Not much is known of Zaihei's personality. However, he becomes overjoyed at being lifted from the Milagroman's curse after suffering from it for two years. He is a fan of Rena Nanami, as he set his PIN number to be based on her name, and photos and posters of her can be seen all over his apartment room. He also doesn't seem to be an organized person, as his room is somewhat messy.

personagens.resumo: Taoka (田岡) is a tertiary character featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.

etymology.texto: 田 (Ta) = Rice field/Rice paddy | 岡 (Oka) = Hill

cod.texto: Neck bone broken by calamitous Equivalent Exchange

Appearance: Taoka is a young adult Japanese man with an average build. He has short, slightly dark hair tied up into two ponytails. One of his most prominent features are swollen pimples on his nose and cheeks. He wears a light-colored coat, a pair of glasses and light colored shoes.
Color Schemes
Personality: Taoka is an ordinary journalist, lacking in notable traits. He is analytical, as when he receives a package containing evidence against the hospital director's research, he quickly understands the situation behind the development of the Locacaca. When he meets the hospital director for an interview, he introduces himself politely. As the interview goes on, he slowly turns confrontational towards the director, and threatens to expose him for his unethical research.

personagens.nome: Do Do Do, De Da Da Da
personagens.nomeWiki: Do Do Do, De Da Da Da
personagens.resumo: Do Do Do, De Da Da Da (ドゥードゥードゥー・デ・ダーダーダー, Dūdūdū De Dādādā) is a tertiary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion, specifically in the "The Wonder of You" story arc.

ja_kanji.texto: ドゥードゥードゥー・デ・ダーダーダー

namesake.texto: De Do Do Do, De Da Da Da (The Police song)

affiliation.texto: Toru / Wonder of U (Master) | Locacaca Organization

cod.texto: Pierced by Mamezuku's Doggy Style

Appearance: It has a physique that is similar to a bamboo sushi mat. The creature has a small spiked head with circular joints attached to its limbs. It has long spider-like mechanical limbs that can stick out from the surface the insect is assimilated to. The ends of its limbs have tiny claws which act as stingers.
Color Schemes
Personality: Do Do Do, De Da Da Da is an invasive carnivorous insect, described by Wonder of U as a hunter from the mountains. It preys on and eats small and medium-sized animals like rabbits and birds by assimilating into rocks and sand on the Earth's surface. However, sometimes it also hunts deer and other large animals. It shows loyalty to Wonder of U as it obeys its commands.
When attacking someone, it prefers to aim for their throats.
Abilities: Scaffolding

When Do Do Do, De Da Da Da stands up, it assembles like scaffolding. Its body forms a crane out of bamboo sticks, carrying a bundle of sticks with a web-like string. It can attack by swinging the string to fire pieces of sticks at its opponent.
Surface Assimilation
Do Do Do, De Da Da Da is capable of assimilating with any surface, such as the floor or a desk, to quickly move toward its target.
Asbestos Manipulation

Do Do Do, De Da Da Da stores asbestos in its stingers at the ends of its limbs. Any living thing pierced by its stingers will spew asbestos out of every hole in their body when they extend themselves. For a human or animal, it is when they extend their joints, whereas for a plant or fruit, it is when they extend after being injured. It helps catch birds and rabbits that like to jump around when escaping. Fruits infested with this ability will appear as if they are diseased.

It can even use its stingers in long-range attacks by melding with different objects. For example, the insect attaches one of its limbs to a stick which it fires toward Josuke, successfully allowing it to sting him while separated from its other limbs.
Mamezuku notes that despite its danger, its poison is not that strong.

personagens.resumo: Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da (オブラディ・オブラダ, Oburadi Oburada) is a tertiary antagonist featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion.

ja_kanji.texto: オブラディ・オブラダ

cod.texto: Drowned in a pool

Appearance: Each Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da looks like a small, flat, round disc resembling a cookie, with six stubs protruding from its edges. It visually has a four-toed paw print on its back. When duplicated, the bodies seem to link together via their stubs. Akefu calls Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da an insect but notes that its species aren't technically insects, as they lack a three-segmented body or jointed legs.
Color Schemes
Personality: Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da is a parasitic Rock Organism, as it feasts on other organisms' blood and bodily fluids. It is shown to be virtually motionless, only moving whenever attacking or being attacked. It is shown to protect its master, Wonder of U, and it can be inferred that it is subservient to Toru. Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da's species target any animal from above or below.
Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da is afraid of water, as it prefers to live in dry areas and is shown to shriek whenever it's submerged underwater. As a Rock Organism, it also hates storms and rising waters.
Abilities: Despite its small size, the organism is shown to be relatively strong enough to deflect a soap bubble shot by Soft & Wet at a high speed.
Latching

Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da can latch itself onto its victims, like a tick, via a highly sticky substance secreted from its underside. This is effective for the Rock Organism to burrow into the victim's skin and absorb their essence. This creature inhabits a cliff in the wilderness and jumps down on other animals passing beneath it. Once latched, it sucks the body fluids and blood of its victim.
Body Replication

Ob-La-Di, Ob-La-Da can spawn copies of itself at a rapid pace from its victim's blood to the point of overwhelming its victim within seconds. Attempting to attack or pull off one of the pads spawns more of its bodies, proving any attack against it seemingly futile. When the body multiplies, its copies form out of one of its stubs.

personagens.resumo: Yoshikage Kira (吉良 吉影, Kira Yoshikage) is a primary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. Introduced early in the story, Kira gains significance in the "Vitamin C and Killer Queen" story arc.

etymology.texto: 吉 (Ki) = Luck/joy | 良 (Ra) = Good/skilled | 吉 (Yoshi) = Luck/joy | 影 (Kage) = Shadow

family.texto: Johnny Joestar (Great-Great-Grandfather) | Joseph Joestar (Grandfather) | Suzi Q (Grandmother) | Barbara Ann Joestar (Aunt) | Jodio Joestar (Cousin) | Dragona Joestar (Cousin) | Yoshiteru Kira (Father) | Holy Joestar-Kira (Mother) | Kei Nijimura (Younger Sister)See: Joestar Family

status.texto: Deceased (Part 8) (Body parts exchanged with Josefumi to form Josuke)

cod.texto: Multiple fatal injuries via Tamaki Damo

Appearance: Kira is a man of slim to medium build and seemingly average height. He has dark eyes and fine features, and wavy black hair of irregular chin-length resembling thin naturally occurring dreads (later appearances depict the same lock of hair as straightened). According to Ojiro Sasame, he has beautiful hands and somehow bore a resemblance to Josuke despite him stating their obvious differences in appearance. He wears a sailor uniform much like Josuke's, though with a tasseled beret or bonnet, in contrast to Josuke's "Dixie cup" style sailor's cap. He possesses a star-shaped birthmark on his left shoulder.
His corpse is discovered without testicles, in contrast with Josuke's four, without a related wound.
Color Schemes
Personality: Although Yoshikage Kira has many unusual and dark personality traits, his love for his mother and loyalty to his allies put him on the side of good.

Kira is a narcissist, keeping sculptures of his own hands around his house, apparently as documents to their ideal state. A copy of the Mona Lisa hangs from a wall in his living room, alluding to the Kira from Diamond is Unbreakable's obsession for beautiful hands although this version of Kira doesn't show the same fetish. He seems to have certain obsessive-compulsive tendencies, keeping an organized stock of entirely green foods, and shelves of containers of his fingernails in his bathroom, labeled by date.

His interactions with others are mostly cold and apathetic, fitting and contrasting his occupation as a surgeon. As a teenager, he immediately jumped to the conclusion that a drowned and unconscious Josefumi was fated to die, showing exasperation when his mother prompted him to manually save the boy's life, only wishing to see Titanic in theater later and leaving the hospital alone because of it. As an adult, when a fellow crew member on his team is injured, sustaining heavy blood loss and the inability to breathe, as the surgeon of the crew, Kira applied little effort to helping him, nonchalantly putting his shoes on before getting out of bed and ordering the others to hold his hand and encourage him, without so much as looking in his direction, his lack of concern was mostly due to presumably knowing the seriousness of the injury and that the crew member was in no life-threatening danger.

He is shown in several instances speaking to Ojiro Sasame in a deliberately confusing and insulting manner, intimidating and threatening him away from the coast in order to rectify Kira's personal problem with him as a surfer; being 'indecisive' about being either a man of the sea or of the land. Apparently, it went to the point that Ojiro ate his own fingers. Another milder instance of Kira brutalizing Ojiro happened when he inserted a small bomb in Ojiro's cheek to chase him away.

However, his sister Nijimura claims that he was not heartless, as he cared for his mother and actively worked to save her from a strange disease. On another occasion, Kira sacrificed his life to save Josefumi when their plan to cultivate and harvest the Locacaca fruit was found out by Yotsuyu and Damo, as he believed Josefumi had no right to die since he was only involved because of Kira's own personal agenda, proving he can be a good loyal friend to those he cares for. His thoughtfulness was also shown the first time he met Yasuho Hirose, as he made sure to kill the Hair Clip that tormented Yasuho while apologizing to her and promising to reimburse the cost.

Kira also shows remarkable spirit in the face of adversity. When Tamaki Damo captured him and Josefumi, Kira showed unwavering defiance, even swearing that he would kill all of them and seize the Locacaca, and at the same time thought up and completed a plan that would help him and Josefumi escape from the Rock Humans.
Kira is one of the few characters who express the belief that there is a kind of fated connection between Stand users.
Abilities: Stand

Kira's Stand is Killer Queen, with the ability to generate bubbles that explode on contact. Part of this Stand is fused to Josefumi Kujo's when the two are buried together, resulting in an upgraded Soft & Wet. The Stand also has an ability called Sheer Heart Attack, which releases several miniature remote controlled bomb tanks.
Medicine

As a doctor, Kira demonstrates an extensive level of medical knowledge and is capable of diagnosing and treating injuries on the spot. While on a cargo ship, he displayed confidence in being able to perform on-site surgery on a man who had lost his eye. Kira's calm personality and Stand ability also assist him in his profession as they allow for an advanced level of precision during medical procedures, such as being to remove a blood clot using Sheer Heart Attack. In relation to being a ship surgeon, Kira is also knowledgeable in sailing boats as seen in the Vitamin C and Killer Queen story arc.

personagens.resumo: Josefumi Kujo (空条 仗世文, Kūjō Josefumi) is a primary ally featured in the eighth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, JoJolion. Josefumi is alluded to in the "Love Love Deluxe" story arc but gains real significance in the "Vitamin C and Killer Queen" arc.

alias.texto: Se-chan (セッちゃん) (by Karera Sakunami) | Josephmi

namesake.texto: Joseph Joestar (In-universe) | Joseph Joestar (Part 2 Protagonist) | Jotaro Kujo (Part 3 Protagonist) | Hōjō clan (Samurai family of the Kamakura shogunate)

etymology.texto: 空 (Ku) = Empty air | 条 (Jo) = Article in a document | 仗 (Jo) = Weapons, typically swords and pole arms; To rely on, guard or escort | 世 (Se) = World/society | 文 (Fumi) = Writing, something written, a letter

family.texto: Unnamed Maternal Grandfather | Sadafumi Kujo (Father) | Kiyomi Kujo (Mother) | Unnamed Half-Sibling

Appearance: Josefumi is a man of slim to medium build and seemingly average height. He is similar to Part 4's Josuke Higashikata in appearance, particularly with his hair styled into a pompadour, albeit smaller and with the sides shaved. Josefumi wears a checker-patterned sweater decorated with metallic peace sign and heart pins, paired with dark slacks.[b] In Karera's photo, he can also be seen wearing a loose-collared shirt underneath his sweater.
During his first appearance, he had multiple irises with a ripple pattern similar to Crazy Diamond.
Color Schemes
Personality: Not much is known about Josefumi Kujo, as he had exchanged parts of his body with Kira's corpse to become Josuke Higashikata prior to the start of JoJolion. In general, Josefumi gives the impression of being an ordinary, kind young man.

Josefumi shows a degree of resourcefulness, using his Stand power and knowledge to concoct a plan that would allow him and Kira to secretly steal some Locacaca branches and cultivate the fruit in secret. When push comes to shove, Josefumi can be remarkably brutal during a fight. When the A. Phex Brothers turned up to assassinate him, Josefumi violently beat them up, inflicting injuries such as kicking their tibias, or flinging a tree branch with enough force to pierce one's head, before inflicting a brutal beatdown with Soft & Wet that sent them down a cliff.

When given the opportunity by Tamaki Damo to let Kira die to save his own life, Josefumi's hidden sadness surfaces as he torments himself, saying that he always was abandoned and left out. He notably remembers the time when his mother Kiyomi almost let him die in the sea, but his manner of speech implies that he's lived an unhappy solitary life. Thus, Josefumi seriously considered revealing the location of the Locacaca to save his life and sacrifice Yoshikage's when both were being tortured by Damo. However, when Kira instead saved him, he was so moved that he attempted to sacrifice his own life to save Kira, showing that he greatly valued their friendship at heart.

He holds a sense of sentiment for Holy Joestar-Kira being grateful towards her for saving his life (with the assistance of her son's power) when he was a boy. Out of gratitude, Josefumi would gladly do anything to help her. It is implied that he sees her as a kind of sacred mother figure.

It doesn't seem that Josefumi ever interacted much with Karera Sakunami, despite her crush on him and her constant stalking. He does find her cute but circumstances made it so he died before anything could happen between them.
Abilities: Stand

Originally Josefumi's Stand, Soft & Wet has the power to create soap bubbles that take away something physical from whatever they touch, an ability that is completely retained post-fusion. Unlike Josuke's version of the Stand, the bubbles lack any star markings.

Josefumi is first shown demonstrating his Stand's ability when Kira unexpectedly meets him in a Morioh ramen shop. After a pepper shaker lid is accidentally knocked off and spills too much pepper into his ramen, Josefumi uses his a soap bubble to extract just the excess pepper and deposit it on the table, completely dry. He is also shown to be able to absorb the contents of a gap and adhere two things together without any ordinary adhesives. He later uses soap bubbles to forcibly feed Kira a fruit of the New Locacaca after the latter is killed by Tamaki Damo.

Appearance: Johnny is a young man with a well-built upper body but paralyzed legs. He has light eyes, and light, shoulder-length hair curling upwards at its ends. Johnny almost always wears a knit cap, printed with many small five-pointed stars. His hair sticks out of holes on either side of the top, taking a shape like short horns. A horseshoe hangs from the front, framing an image of the dark silhouette of the profile of a horse's reared head. When Johnny uses his Stand Tusk, small stars appear on his hands. While it is not seen, Johnny bears the Star Birthmark, as Lucy Steel is aware of it. After being shot by Funny Valentine, he bears a scar on each cheek for the remainder of the battle with the president.

Throughout the Steel Ball Run race, Johnny gradually changes into a more realistic appearance, with slightly wavy hair and a slightly fuller build. At the same time, he dons various outfits to suit the weather across America, each outfit retaining the star patterns of his hat and legs and the stripes on his torso.

As a paraplegic, Johnny uses a wheelchair before the race begins. During the race, however, he is usually mounted on his horse, Slow Dancer. He is the only mounted competitor in the Steel Ball Run who spends the majority of the race without using his stirrups; instead, his legs remain tucked and tied against the horse's flanks, or are sometimes secured to the saddle to prevent him from falling.
